author: Unity
description:
Unity 6.6 is here with major performance and build improvements, Editor workflow upgrades, new graphics and 2D features, UI enhancements, and platform updates. In this video, we cover what’s new in Unity 6.6, including faster Enter Play Mode, Dictionary serialization, Build Analysis and content directories, the new Hierarchy window, Shader Build Settings and DXC support, 2D lighting and profiling improvements, Shader Graph features, Graph Toolkit debugging, UI Toolkit visual effects, WebGPU, progressive asset loading, and more. 

🔗 Unity 6.6 is a supported release. For more details and highlights, check out our discussion post: https://on.unity.com/6-6_Discussions
🔗 Learn more and upgrade: https://on.unity.com/6_6_Docs
🔗 Read what else is new in 6.6: https://on.unity.com/New6_6_Docs
🔗Check out the 6.6 upgrade guide: https://on.unity.com/UpgradeTo6_6_Docs

[00:18] Fast Enter Playmode
[03:12] Dictionary Serialization
[04:18] Build Analysis
[04:58] Content Directorie
